chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sam'ah, from more than one, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abdillah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said regarding a man who married a woman but did not specify her dowry, then he consummated the marriage with her: 'She is entitled to the dowry of her equals.'

key_terms.دَخَلَ بِهَا: He consummated the marriage (entered with her)
key_terms.صَدَاقُ نِسَائِهَا: The dowry of her equals (mahr al-mithl)

ai.seo_question: What is the dowry entitlement if a husband does not specify a mahr before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: In al-Istibsar, Shaykh al-Tusi records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishing that if a man consummates marriage without specifying a fixed dowry (sadaq), the wife is entitled to 'mahr al-mithl' (the dowry of her equals). This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that consummation validates the marriage contract and triggers the obligation of a fair, customary dowry based on the woman's social status, lineage, and beauty, ensuring her financial rights are protected even in the absence of an explicit agreement.
